metadata.description: Cogniva's plugin suite for general-purpose development and project management

plugins.name: cogniva-dev
plugins.description: Cogniva's development toolkit: pre-planning idea exploration (explore-idea), technical experiment design, recording and review (investigate), human-confirmed architectural decision records with provenance and relitigation weight (adr), deferred work capture and grooming (backlog, groom-backlog), low-involvement work selection (easy-work-scan), repo scaffolding (repo-init, add-module), the feature lifecycle (plan-feature, execute-feature, quick-fix) with optional per-clone isolated-worktree execution and ledger-based cleanup (cleanup-work, cleanup-allwork), Module dependency-graph generation (module-deps), and read-only status roll-ups (feature-status, module-status, repo-status, workflow-status).

plugins.name: cogniva-skills
plugins.description: Cogniva's general-purpose toolkit: glossary, reference, project-requirement, and project-context skills for any project
